description: This file defines the class Zend_XmlRpc_Client, implementing an XML-RPC client with methods for sending requests, handling responses, and managing configurations related to XML-RPC communication. It also includes several require_once statements referencing other related classes and interfaces essential for XML-RPC operations in the Zend Framework.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Client
classes.description: This class provides an implementation of an XML-RPC client capable of communicating with a remote XML-RPC server. It manages request creation, transport via HTTP, response handling, and offers proxy and introspection features for remote method invocation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the XML-RPC client with the server URL and optional HTTP client.

methods.name: setHttpClient
methods.description: Sets the HTTP client used for communication.

methods.name: getHttpClient
methods.description: Retrieves the current HTTP client instance.

methods.name: setIntrospector
methods.description: Assigns a remote server introspector object.

methods.name: getLastRequest
methods.description: Returns the last created request object.

methods.name: getLastResponse
methods.description: Returns the last received response object.

methods.name: getProxy
methods.description: Provides a proxy object for calling namespaced XML-RPC methods.

methods.name: setSkipSystemLookup
methods.description: Configures whether to skip system method lookup.

methods.name: skipSystemLookup
methods.description: Checks if system lookup is skipped.

methods.name: doRequest
methods.description: Performs the XML-RPC request and processes the response, handling HTTP errors.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Main method for invoking remote procedures with parameters, handling type casting and faults.

methods.name: _createRequest
methods.description: Creates a new XML-RPC request object with specified method and parameters.

calls: try-catch block around getMethodSignature() and related logic
